name: Loving Your Brother And Sister
overview: Scripture calls believers to demonstrate genuine love and kindness toward their brothers and sisters in Christ, reflecting the example of Christ’s own love (John 13:34). This love includes honoring one another above ourselves and showing tenderhearted forgiveness, just as God has forgiven us through Christ (Romans 12:10; Ephesians 4:32). Jesus warns against harboring anger or contempt toward a brother, emphasizing reconciliation even before worship (Matthew 5:22-23). Wisdom is shown by heeding correction and valuing godly instruction in our relationships (Proverbs 15:5).
